title: Stoner Light (No Updates)
description: The light Version of Stoner for mc
body:
Stoner Light is the official light-themed counterpart to the original Stoner Dark aesthetic. Designed for users who prefer clarity and brightness without sacrificing the sleek, modern feel of the Stoner series. This version reimagines every visual element—from menus to UI components—using a refined, high-contrast palette that ensures maximum readability in well-lit environments.
No updates up to 1.13.5 for now
